reason: zod 3.25.x is pulled in only by @expo/cli, a build-time command line tool that is not part of the shipped app bundle. The flaw is memory exhaustion when validating oversized collections of untrusted input; the CLI only reads our own app.json. No patched 3.x exists and the fix (zod 4.6.6) needs an Expo major downgrade. Re-check when Expo ships a CLI built on zod 4.
